component.name: Cadence
component.summary: Panoramic turntable music player with synced lyrics and DSP audio visualizer

description.p: Cadence is a studio-grade music player designed for the Linux desktop, featuring a panoramic turntable deck, synchronized karaoke-style lyrics, and real-time DSP spectrum visualizers.

ul.li: Analog Turntable Deck: Realistic vinyl micro-grooves, dynamic tonearm physics, 33/45 RPM switcher, and precision needle-drop scrubbing.
Synced Lyrics: Apple-grade typography, active line magnification, fluid glow effects, and zero-latency timestamp synchronization powered by LRCLIB.
Multi-Mode DSP Spectrum: 120 FPS high-resolution audio visualizer with Neon Bars, Fluid Wave, Starburst, and Oscilloscope visualizations.
Audiophile DSP Suite: 10-band graphic equalizer, bass boost, spatial sound stage enhancement, and sleep timer with exponential volume fade.
Ultrawide & Cinema Mode: Optimized for 32:9 panoramic displays with OLED true-black void mode and dynamic multi-color ambient bloom.

description.p: Cadence 3.0.0 introduces Apple-grade ergonomics, dock themes, high-resolution audio visualizer, motion blur, and zero-latency lyrics sync.

ul.li: Real-time resolution auto-scaling for ultrawide 32:9 and high-DPI displays
Dynamic ambient bloom pulling saturated colors from album covers
Customizable floating bottom dock with compact and full themes
Apple-grade settings layout with streamlined toggles and performance metrics
Zero-latency lyrics synchronization and resilient search fallback
